$comment: The agent's lever. Modify this file between experiments and re-run experiment.py. See ./program.md for what's safe to change. The runner reads this file fresh on every invocation; no daemon restart needed.

stacked._note: Run multiple sub-mechanisms back-to-back inside the same snapshot bracket. Each phase reads its own sub-config block above. memorize first to lift forward, entity_masked_sft second to harden probe.

entity_masked_sft._note: SOTA track 2 supplement: weighted_sft with span_prefix='Answer: ' so the loss only supervises the trailing answer token(s).

hybrid_presample_unlike._note: SOTA track 1 (feedback-guided loss), pre-sample variant — sample first at cold T=0.8, push unlike on wrong rollouts, THEN memorize on demonstration. The order matters: post-memorize the sampling distribution is too tight to produce wrong rollouts (see exp-009 — wrong_count=0 for all 5 tasks). K=5 for fair comparison with memorize baseline.

self_synth._note: SOTA track 3 (self-synthesization / mental modeling) — for each task, ask the model to paraphrase the question m times. Keep paraphrases the model still answers correctly (semantic preservation check). Memorize on the original + each kept paraphrase. Distributional broadening from the model's own representations.

memorize._note: Strong-learning regime per R-001b: patience=10 + max_steps=100 + explicit lr=5e-4 actually moves the model (vs default plateau_patience=3 which bails at 3 steps and produces near-zero gradient). n_train_samples is the per-sample efficiency knob — push down to find the minimum K that produces a forward gain. stratify_by_domain rotates across domains so K=10 covers all 10. task_ids overrides selection entirely. Best known config: K=5 unstratified (exp-002, exp-013, exp-019 all hit 0.60). n=0 = pure no-op for cold-baseline diagnostic.

rlvr._note: Stubbed — promote memorize→rlvr only when memorize hits a ceiling.

eval._note: enable_thinking=false avoids Qwen3 <think>...</think> blocks consuming the whole budget before any content. Bumping max_tokens >= 3000 is an alternative if you want chain-of-thought. Winning config: max_tokens=3000 (exp-028 confirmed 6000 ties at 0.70 — no benefit from longer thinking).
